title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Closing Allowance Owed to the Agency, by Option
content:
In auditing an agency payment under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the closing allowance owed to the agency depends on why the billed rental closed, as recorded on its closing in the claim's rental ledger:

- a rental closed because repairs were complete is owed the option's repair-complete grace days beyond its authorized days;
- a rental closed because a total-loss settlement was offered is owed the option's total-loss end days beyond its authorized days;
- a rental closed for any other reason is owed none.

| Option | Closed: repairs complete | Closed: total-loss settlement offered | Closed: any other reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 30/900 | 1 day | 3 days | None |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200 | 1 day | 3 days | None |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500 | 1 day | 3 days | None |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 60/1800 | 1 day | 5 days | None |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 75/2250 | 1 day | 5 days | None |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 100/3000 | 1 day | 5 days | None |

"Any other reason" covers a closing for coverage denied, benefit exhausted, customer returned or liability transferred.

*Example (hypothetical):* A billed rental under 60/1800 had 10 authorized days and closed because a total-loss settlement was offered. It is owed 5 days beyond its authorized days, which makes 15 days.
